name: sidebar
label: Sidebar
description: A collapsible application sidebar with offcanvas, icon, and floating variants, built from composable header/content/group/footer parts.

props.name: side
props.description: Which edge of the viewport the sidebar is docked to.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the sidebar surface.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: How the sidebar collapses: slide fully offscreen, shrink to icon-only, or stay fixed.

slots.name: slot
slots.description: Sidebar content, composed of header/content/group/footer parts.

studio.card: Full-page layout — open the docs to preview.

usage: Wrap with <x-sidebar.container> and compose the inside using <x-sidebar.header>, <x-sidebar.content>, <x-sidebar.group>, <x-sidebar.nav-item>, <x-sidebar.nav-dropdown>, <x-sidebar.footer>, <x-sidebar.trigger>, and <x-sidebar.toggle>.

examples.title: Application layout
examples.description: Compose header, content, group and footer inside the container.
